Friendzy / 100 Never Have I Ever questions

100 Never Have I Ever questions

Never Have I Ever is the easiest party game there is: someone reads a statement, and everyone who has done it puts a finger down (or takes a point). These 100 questions are clean and funny, so they work for teens, family nights and mixed groups.

How to play

  1. Everyone holds up five (or ten) fingers.
  2. Take turns reading a statement that starts with “Never have I ever…”.
  3. Anyone who has done it puts a finger down, and tells the story if the group asks.
  4. The last player with fingers up wins.
